title: CurrentLyrics
description: Lyrics of the song playing now. Payload of the `lyrics-changed` event (sent to every window on a song change, when lyrics load, on an offset change and on a pick) and the result of `get_current_lyrics`. Produced by `CurrentLyrics` in src-tauri/src/lyrics/mod.rs.

video_id.description: YouTube video id of the song these lyrics belong to; null when unknown.

provider.description: Where the lyrics came from; null while loading or when none were found.

synced.description: Timed lines sorted by `t`; empty when only plain text (or nothing) is available.

t.description: Line start, seconds from the start of the song.

words.description: Word-by-word timing when the provider has it. Concatenating `text` of all words gives the line text (spaces stay on the preceding word).

t.description: Word start, seconds from the start of the song.

plain.description: Untimed lyrics, lines separated by \n. Present alongside `synced` for most providers.

offset_secs.description: User's timing correction for this song. Positive = lyrics run ahead: a line is active once `position + offset_secs >= t`.

source_url.description: Page of these lyrics on the provider's site, when it has one.
